notes.title: Dev update 4.4.2 - New track & air physics update!
notes.content:
Hello sportsfans! How has your summer been? Since going back from vacation is hard, I thought you would like a treat. 
In the form of a new track!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/270ee6297e0a15d8caa68857cf4b12061eeda30d.png[/img]

Hangtime Fest is a jump line filled with [b]the biggest features the game has seen so far.[/b] It is inspired by the Fest series and Hardline, and it includes 3 huge booters, a hardline-sized drop and the fastest berms your bike can handle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/937e1e599af78776cc2315f70556269686a1e393.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/7d1a1432ca588c68a6384518db1f56e44bbe3932.png[/img]

Also, [b]an important update has been made to air physics.[/b] [b]Now the bike is more stable in the air, and bringing the whips back to straight has improved significantly. Just let go of the Left Stick[/b] and the bike will straighten up automatically. You can even make it go back to straight faster with a quick press of the Right Trigger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/3ec2c9b226469633d1d3a328739185b0f6671d3c.png[/img]

Please note that the extreme high speeds that some of the jumps in this track require, sometimes can be frustrating as the collision model of the tyres can reach its limits. Be patient and don't expect to clear all the jumps first go. They are all doable, I asure you, but it might take some practice. 

TIP 1: Pump with RT all the downslopes to get the bike pressed into the ground and use Balance (A) to keep it settled when going straight. 
TIP 2: use Tuck (B button) on the runway to the booters for extra speed.

I hope you like it!
Germán

notes.title: Dev update 4.3.3 - New track!
notes.content:
Good news sportsfans! We have a new track to play!

Rollercoaster is a jump trail, where speeds are high and big airtime is ensured. It is inspired by some of the world's most famous bikepark trails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/c78c9ac4bc4c1f3b0fc9464f20f3295aed7712a7.png[/img]

It has some unique features, like a big wallride or a tyretap over a stone. Tricky to get first time, may take a few tries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/635d560d4635e8bca5c5eb88fe6523ee81b33a8a.png[/img]

It is packed with doubles and triples for you to practice your jumping skills. Pick a creative line, and shred it! Of course, if you like it, you can share your best moves on our Discord, hope to see your videos and screenshots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/2a074db3889290327f7303df2c656b5296ea3aa1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/c5b4455489d1454741dca0fbbfaaa2732a6b383f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/f809c696109c26efb7ca3b83e1ddf64868cd9f63.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/dae8c3af005729494e3c1a0e2c9622585f684ec1.png[/img]

Cheers!
Germán

notes.title: Downhill Pro Racer release!
notes.content:
Hello sports fans! I am so pleased to announce that Downhill Pro Racer is live!
From 10.00h UTC (Universal Time) all players will be able to join the game in early release and experience the thrill of downhill MTB on their hands.

Note that the Early Release means the game is not complete. That means that content will grow with updates quite frecuently.

You can expect new tracks, new mountains, new riders, new bikes, new gear... as the game progresses to its final release.

Also, new physics based rider model is in the works, a feature that will unlock pretty spectacular crashes!

My aim is to make DHPR the reference title for the sport of mountain biking.

So, please take a seat, join the community, and let's have fun riding (digital) bikes!

notes.title: DEV PROGRESS: Build 0.2.09
notes.content:
Hello downhill fans! Let's see a quick review of the curent build status:

[list]
    [*]Physics starting to feel good for alpha phase. The Line selection tool does a great job at improving precission with steering, bike weight and air physics also feel very good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/d5d7e7b13a091aed6825367def44a37d621934e4.jpg[/img]
    [*]Camera follow has been reworked and improved. Replay system works but some minor bugs still need clearing.

    [*]Bike graphics have been improved with new tyres model. Still kind of basic but the focus right now is on handling rather than looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/e7d8f3789ba475376215822bc033168681c46ab5.jpg[/img]

    [*]Timing system has been updated with split times (green or red from your best lap) 

    [*]Track markers and tape have been implemented. In timed runs, breaking the tape results in reseting to a previous track point, and loss of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475019/dea1b16925e613dd4da4d88ca6eec8c20bac134c.jpg[/img]


[/list]

Current Work-In-Progress:
[list]
    [*]Crash Manager: Implement conditions for crashing, and ragdoll physics.

    [*]Audio: the audio right now is very basic, needs lots of work.

    [*]Menus also need work.

    [*]Tutorials for pre-release beta testers.

    [*]Tracks refinement and visual upgrades.
[/list]

Will keep posting as the game progresses, cheers!
